status: Prepared specification; not applied while the saving fault is being recovered.
serverInvariants: Account email remains case-insensitively unique across login accounts; a dependent profile may have no email or login.
MemberProfile_Account is a database-constrained one-to-one association. Only guarded account binding can set it.
An active profile with active guardian links references exactly one active, verified same-profile main link.
A dependent without an own account cannot lose its last active guardian.
Pending, expired, revoked or unverified links never grant delegated permissions.
Only the profile's own login or its main guardian may invite, change delegated permissions or transfer main status.

Every mutation reads the current profile revision and inserts a database-unique ProfileKey:Revision claim before writing. It increments Revision in the same transaction; a competing mutation rolls back and requests a refresh.
Every guardian mutation writes an immutable audit entry; audit and claim fields are not editable from the client.
Invitation acceptance requires a sent, unexpired single-use token, the intended signed-in recipient account, and a current authorized inviter. It never grants unrelated profile access.
Profile creation first uses an inaccessible Setup state, then creates the initial active link and main reference before changing State to Active.
Membership identity and duplicate checks use Profile+Club+Type+Season. Payer and creator accounts are separate audit/communication fields.
Legacy Invoice_Person remains the beneficiary's own login, never the guardian payer; otherwise revocation would fail to remove invoice access.

migration.guardedAction: Platform administrator only; idempotent backfill and validation before exposing guardian UI.
steps: Create or reuse one own profile per existing UserManagement.Person account.
Backfill Membership_Profile and RegistrationRequest_Profile from existing beneficiary Person associations.
Backfill Invoice_BeneficiaryProfile, RenewalOffer_Profile, BillingPlan_Profile and federation projections from the associated registration/membership beneficiary.
Preserve legacy Person links as compatibility data; child profiles do not put the parent in beneficiary Person links.
Update all server authorization, duplicate detection, dashboard data sources, club content access, federation count keys and payment intent guards before enabling dependent registration.
Validate totals and ownership before/after migration. Do not rewrite paid invoice snapshots.
Do not auto-merge profiles by name/date of birth or claim an existing profile by matching an email.

publicFlows.name: ACT_Dependent_Create
publicFlows.purpose: Create a new dependent profile and initial main guardian; never claim an existing person.

publicFlows.name: ACT_Guardian_Manage
publicFlows.purpose: One guarded mutation boundary for invite/permissions/transfer/revoke and audited administrator recovery.

publicFlows.name: ACT_Guardian_Accept
publicFlows.purpose: Accept a verified mailed invitation while logged into the intended account.

publicFlows.name: DS_ActingProfiles
publicFlows.purpose: Own profile plus active verified CanRegister profiles.

publicFlows.name: ACT_Profile_Save
publicFlows.purpose: Guarded own/main profile edits with revision check.

publicFlows.name: ACT_Dependent_EnableLogin
publicFlows.purpose: Queue an ordinary account invitation for an authorized dependent without a login; bind its profile only on secure redemption.

MemberProfile.own: Name and date of birth read-only
MemberProfile.guardianCanRegister: Name and date of birth read-only
MemberProfile.guardianCanPay: Name only; issued beneficiary invoices read-only
MemberProfile.clubAdmin: Name only through this club's registrations/memberships; no family links
MemberProfile.federationAdmin: No profile access; projection fields only

GuardianInvitation.inviter: Email/status/expiry read-only; hash and recipient account links None

access.guardianPayer: Issued invoices only through a current active verified CanPay link. No permanent invoice read grant merely because an account paid earlier.
access.registrationAnswers: Draft edits only for the beneficiary's own account or current active CanRegister guardian; submitted answers read-only. Club access remains club-scoped.

tests: Concurrent main transfer and revocation; one revision claim wins and the loser reloads.
Revoked guardian with a still-open browser cannot retrieve child invoices or registrations.
Two guardians submitting for one child produce one request/membership; two children with one payer remain two distinct members.
Forged profile/link parameters cannot select another family.
Own-account linkage cannot attach a second profile or steal an already linked child.
Wrong-account, expired, reused, revoked and unsent guardian tokens fail.
No mail setup means invitations remain Queued and access remains Pending.
Paid invoice beneficiary/issuer snapshots and totals do not change after main transfer.
Checkout is scoped to the acting payer and duplicate provider callbacks cannot double-mark or double-charge an invoice.
